title: Shooting Variation 3 - Shooting On The Turn

source.file: archive/sample-april-20-23/Shooting Variation 3 - Shooting On The Turn.pdf
source.originalFilename: Shooting Variation 3 - Shooting On The Turn.pdf

setup: Two large goals, two poles (=defenders), two lines of players. Each player with a ball. Poles should be 12 yards (U8, U10) to 15 yards (U12, U14) from goal. Line of players at A and D, target players at B and E, goalies at C and F.
instructions: A passes to B, who turns with one touch and shoots with the next touch.
D passes to E, who turns with one touch and shoots on the next touch.
Rotation: A goes to B, B goes to C, C goes to A. D to E to F, to D.
Play as soon as the player ahead of you takes the shoot - keep it moving!
coachingPoints: Passes must have good pace and be on the ground.
Turn with one touch, pushing the ball away from the defender and slightly behind him.
Turn with the inside of one foot (toes pointing up), or with the outside of the other (toes pointing down).
The next touch must be a shot.
Shoot side on, aiming for the back post.
Focus on proper shooting technique/body mechanics.
